instruction: Right now you're facing towards a door. Now slightly turn right and exit the washroom. Now you are facing towards a sofa, there is an open entrance to your left, slightly turn left and move towards the entrance. Now again slightly turn left, there is a round marble with a design on it, move towards the round marble and turn right, there are two portraits on the wall in front of you, move towards the portraits and slightly turn left. There is an entrance in front of you, move towards the entrance and enter in to the room and move forward in between the sofa and the chairs which are to your left and right, at the end of the sofa slightly turn left. You can see a black table and a sofa in front of you and a mirror on the wall, move towards the black table and stand in front of it facing towards the mirror. Now slightly turn right and cross the sofa which is in front of you. Now again slightly turn right and exit the room through the open entrance. There are couches and a table in front of you, move forward. There are some bushes in front of you, move towards the bushes and stand in front of them, facing towards the corner of the balcony and the river and it is your end point.
